lines.55631ca52f: March in place. March in place and swing your arms. Start easy and get a little faster.
lines.77f1b4f421: Arm circles. Arms out to the sides. Small circles forward, then backward.
lines.0a98102023: Hip circles. Hands on your hips. Make slow circles one way, then the other.
lines.472e38cb1s: Easy squats. Eight easy squats to a chair. Slow and comfortable.
lines.788f40e23a: Good mornings. Hands on your hips. Push your hips back and tip forward with a flat back, then stand tall. Eight times.
lines.616294081j: Wall push-ups. Eight easy wall push-ups. You are ready.
lines.fb73b0f12n: Slow breathing. Walk slowly or stand still. Breathe in through your nose for four, out for six.
lines.abb62cfd2p: Calf stretch. Hands on the wall, one foot back with the heel down. Hold twenty seconds each side.
lines.0b0f182f2t: Thigh stretch. Hold the wall, bend one knee and hold your ankle behind you. Twenty seconds each side.
lines.4f05efa93r: Hamstring stretch. Heel on a low step, leg straight. Hinge forward with a flat back until you feel a stretch. Twenty seconds each side.
lines.b05c5c8d3f: Doorway chest stretch. Forearms on the door frame, step through gently until you feel a stretch across your chest. Breathe.
lines.9ceefb482f: Wall push-up. Hands on the wall at shoulder height, a little wider than your shoulders.
lines.3f4d1e8c1u: Countertop push-up. Hands on the edge of a sturdy kitchen counter.
lines.f6dcda132s: Knee push-up. Hands under your shoulders, knees on a mat or towel, body straight from head to knees.
lines.4f6fd89d29: Full push-up. Hands under your shoulders, on your toes, body in a straight plank.
lines.0aca59982i: Sit-to-stand, with hands. Sit at the front of a sturdy chair with its back against a wall.
lines.98f112242o: Sit-to-stand, no hands. Sit on a sturdy chair, arms crossed over your chest or reaching forward.
lines.28e16c5a1s: Bodyweight squat. Feet shoulder-width, toes turned out a little.
lines.caf7b20b3s: Tempo squat. A bodyweight squat in slow motion: take three seconds to lower, pause for one second at the bottom, then stand up normally.
lines.c87d9afd2q: Goblet squat. Hold a dumbbell, a full water jug or a heavy bag against your chest with both hands.
lines.4f8632013g: Hip hinge with a broomstick. Hold a broomstick along your back so it touches the back of your head, upper back and tailbone.
lines.1b0c98932m: Glute bridge. Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat and hip-width, heels close to your seat.
lines.abfa592e2a: Single-leg glute bridge. Set up like a bridge, then straighten one leg in the air.
lines.60a616103t: Romanian deadlift with household weight. Hold dumbbells, a loaded backpack by its straps, or two full water jugs in front of your thighs.
lines.935975f92f: Doorway row. Stand in a solid doorway and hold both sides of the frame at chest height.
lines.45aec3722s: Band row. Door anchor at chest height, facing the door; step back until the band is taut, arms long.
lines.ba46baa21v: Backpack row. Put one hand and one knee on a sturdy chair or bench.
lines.118d5e6321: Dead bug. Lie on your back, arms straight up, knees bent above your hips.
lines.f94d56481y: Bird-dog. On hands and knees, hands under shoulders, knees under hips.
lines.60df985d23: Knee plank. Forearms on the floor, elbows under your shoulders, knees down.
lines.223665351s: Plank. Forearms down, elbows under your shoulders, on your toes.
lines.9e5c842b2r: Plank shoulder taps. High plank on your hands (drop to your knees if needed), feet wider than hips.
lines.27589cac2e: Suitcase carry. Hold a heavy grocery bag, jug or dumbbell in one hand like a suitcase.
lines.eec286d71d: Farmer's carry. Heavy bags or jugs in both hands.
lines.010951481x: Calf raise at the wall. Stand tall holding a wall or counter lightly.
lines.223ae3671v: Single-leg calf raise. Hold the wall lightly and stand on one foot.
lines.85cdf0c81w: Band squat. Stand on the band, handles at your shoulders, elbows in.
lines.fee1f19c2s: Band chest press. Door anchor at chest height, facing away; handles at your chest, one foot forward.
lines.2212648a24: Band Romanian deadlift. Stand on the band, hands at your thighs, knees soft.
lines.9b85b58c29: Band overhead press. Stand on the band, handles at your shoulders, palms forward.
lines.074726632t: Pallof press. Door anchor at chest height, stand side-on with both hands on the handle at your chest.
lines.6574a3e423: Glute bridge with band. Loop above your knees, on your back with feet flat.
lines.4caec35d20: Lateral band walk. Loop above your knees, a quarter squat, toes forward.
lines.689f991a1p: Band pull-apart. Hold the band at shoulder height, arms long.
lines.152623d71x: Clamshell with band. On your side, knees bent, loop above your knees.
lines.0b872bad1h: Breathing and pelvic floor. On your back, knees bent.
lines.d7c0d2c512: Heel slides. On your back, knees bent.
lines.6d985593p: Move up a band next time.
lines.598b740b10: Breathe in, and let your belly rise.
lines.f4491ccf10: Breathe out slowly, and lift gently.
lines.4c54d5fcz: Slow and gentle. That is the point.
